items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank: September Jobs Data Still Points to a Stable Labour Market

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank: September Jobs Data Still Points to a Stable Labour Market
evidence.snippet: September payrolls disappointed, with headline employment rising 29K and private payrolls 46K, alongside 60K of downward revisions to the previous two months. Average hourly earnings also slowed to 0.1% month-on-month, although labour-income growth remained relatively firm at an annualised 4.2%, still supportive of consumer spending. The household survey was more encouraging. The unemployment rate edged only slightly higher to 4.175%, while the U-6 rate fell to 7.6%, employment rose by 406K and labour-force participation climbed to 61.8%, its highest since May. Prime-age participation and employment rates also continued to recover. Overall, the labour market still looks broadly stable, with low firing, resilient hiring indicators and some signs of tightening in parts of the economy, leaving the Fed more focused on inflation. The base case remains for two further 25bp hikes over the next couple of quarters.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: CACIB: Less urgency to hike after September jobs report, though underlying details not as bad

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: CACIB: Less urgency to hike after September jobs report, though underlying details not as bad
evidence.snippet: September’s jobs report was weaker than expected on the headline measures, with nonfarm payrolls rising just 29K versus 90K expected, alongside 60K of downward revisions to the previous two months. Even so, the three-month average remained at 51K, which may still be around or slightly above breakeven given lower immigration. The unemployment rate edged up to 4.2%, but the increase largely reflected stronger participation, while household employment rose by more than 400K. Average hourly earnings increased just 0.1% month-on-month, slowing annual growth to 3.0% and reinforcing the view that the labour market is not a major source of inflation pressure. The softer report may reduce the urgency for an October Fed hike, but it does not materially change the broader assessment of a labour market with low hiring and low firing. Inflation data are expected to remain more important for near-term Fed policy, with the base case still for a hold in October followed by another hike in December.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: High Energy Prices Persist, but Global Growth Remains Surprisingly Resilient

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: High Energy Prices Persist, but Global Growth Remains Surprisingly Resilient
evidence.snippet: Geopolitical tensions continue to drive the outlook through energy markets. Oil supply losses from the Persian Gulf have proved harder to offset than the Russian disruption in 2022, keeping the forecast for Brent relatively elevated at around $95 a barrel through late 2026 and 2027. Europe also faces renewed natural gas risks, with inventories unusually low, Qatari LNG still absent and Asian demand expected to keep the market tight into 2027. Despite high energy costs, persistent inflation and tighter monetary conditions, growth remains relatively resilient. US GDP is forecast at 2.1% in 2026 and 2.0% in 2027, supported by strong AI investment, a still-solid labour market, supportive fiscal policy and household wealth. US inflation is expected to average 3.4% in 2026 before slowing to 2.3% in 2027. Emerging economies are also holding up well, helped by domestic demand and exports tied to metals, hydrocarbons and AI. China is expected to grow around 4.5% in both 2026 and 2027, although weak domestic demand and inflation of only around 1% suggest deflationary pressures remain.

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: MUFG: The EUR
evidence.snippet: The euro has come under further pressure as the sharp sell-off in French government bonds raises concerns about broader financial instability and renewed fragmentation risks across the Eurozone. The deterioration has begun to spread beyond France, with Italian government bonds also coming under pressure, raising concerns that widening spreads could interfere with the transmission of ECB monetary policy. The resulting tightening in financial conditions has already led markets to scale back expectations for further ECB rate hikes, while lower German short-term yields reflect the growing belief that financial conditions may do some of the ECB’s tightening for it. This creates a difficult policy dilemma for the ECB. Markets are increasingly considering whether the central bank may need to slow quantitative tightening or eventually use its Transmission Protection Instrument to contain disorderly bond-market moves. However, activating the TPI could create political and market concerns over the ECB effectively supporting government financing, meaning any intervention would likely require temporary purchases alongside credible fiscal adjustment. The current market pricing is broadly consistent with expectations for two further hikes, although renewed fragmentation could make even that path difficult to achieve. France’s latest budget plans have so far failed to restore confidence, with the government targeting a reduction in the deficit through significant fiscal tightening. Political uncertainty remains a major obstacle, however, given the government’s lack of a parliamentary majority, doubts over whether the measures will pass and the proximity of next year’s presidential election. evidence.snippet: 호르무즈 해협의 원유 수송량이 급격한 반등세를 보이고 있습니다: 지난주 페르시아만 원유 수출량은 2월 28일 이란 전쟁 발발 이후 처음으로 일일 1,400만 배럴을 넘어섰습니다. 이는 지난 3월 기록했던 일일 약 450만 배럴 저점 대비 +210% 이상 증가한 수치입니다. 그 결과, 4주 이동평균선은 6개월 만에 최고치인 일일 1,400만 배럴까지 올라섰습니다. 현재 페르시아만 원유 수출량은 개전 이전 수준의 약 80%까지 회복되었습니다. 이는 미군이 호르무즈 해협의 안보를 강화하고 오만 연안을 따라 양방향 해상 통로를 구축함에 따라, 유조선 호송 작전을 통해 수로 운항이 재개될 수 있었던 덕분입니다. 한편, 휘발유와 경유, 항공유를 포함한 정제유 운송량은 개전 이전 대비 약 50% 수준에 머물러 있습니다. 이들 정제 제품은 원유에 비해 운송 비용이 더 많이 드는 데다, 전쟁 초기 피해를 입었던 페르시아만 내 일부 정유소들이 아직 온전히 가동을 재개하지 못했기 때문입니다. 원유 수송 흐름은 되살아나고 있으나, 연료 시장은 여전히 상당한 압박을 받고 있습니다.

evidence.snippet: 여론조사는 언제나 마가를 과소평가해 왔습니다. 그들은 투표를 억누르려 애쓰지만, 저는 올해 7개 경합주 모두에서 승리했고, 전국 득표수에서도 이겼으며, 전체 카운티의 86%, 그리고 예비선거(경선)의 99%에서 압승을 거뒀습니다. 이번 투표용지에 오른 것은 바로 저 자신입니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령 딕 모리스의 분석 : "2025년 11월 이후 맥러플린(McLaughlin)의 매월 여론조사에서 대통령님의 국정 지지율은 항상 47%에서 50% 사이를 유지해 왔습니다. 50년간 여론조사를 지켜보며 이런 수치는 단 한 번도 본 적이 없습니다. 거의 모든 정치인은 매달 지지율이 오르내리기 마련이지만 대통령님은 그렇지 않습니다. 대통령님께서는 2024년 대선에서 49.8%의 득표율로 승리하셨고, 이번 달에 실시된 최신 맥러플린 조사에서도 국정 지지율이 49%로 집계되었습니다 — 당시 득표율과 완전히 일치하는 수치입니다. 그 어떤 정치인도 지지율에서 이 정도의 견고한 일관성을 보여준 적이 없습니다. 이란 전쟁과 유가 등락을 거치면서도 대통령님의 국정 지지율은 그대로였습니다. 결코 흔들리지 않습니다. 그리고 49%는 승리하기에 충분한 수치입니다 — 2024년에 그 정도의 득표율로 어떻게 승리했는지를 보십시오! 같은 맥러플린 조사에서 정당 지지율(generic ballot)은 50대 48로 민주당이 앞서는 것으로 나타났습니다. 하지만 이 정도 격차 역시 공화당이 하원 다수당을 지켜내기에 충분한 수준입니다. 과거 역사를 보면 민주당의 격차가 4%포인트 미만일 경우, 공화당이 하원에서 승리할 가능성이 매우 높음을 가리키고 있습니다. 게다가 거의 모든 여론조사에서 정당 지지율상 공화당의 상승세가 뚜렷하게 나타나고 있습니다."
